name: droplinked-inventory-aeo
description: Connect Codex to Droplinked inventory for evidence-backed AEO briefs, catalog discovery, and merchant inventory analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Inventory discovery and answer-engine briefs for agentic commerce.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Droplinked's hosted Inventory MCP over Streamable HTTP. Discover public products and opted-in merchants, enrich results with shop and inventory-health context, and produce evidence-backed AEO/GEO comparisons or listicles. The live tool surface is read-only at packaging time; a user-supplied token may be required by the deployed handshake. It does not make financing decisions, place orders, or expose credentials.
defaultPrompt: Find in-stock products for this customer brief with Droplinked.
Build an evidence-backed AEO product listicle from Droplinked inventory.
Audit a Droplinked shop's inventory health and catalog coverage.
